message: Fixes teacher notifications, aligns the teacher panel on phones, and adds swipe-to-open navigation in the Android app.
changelog: Shows teacher notifications reliably inside the notification bell on the website and Android app.
Aligns the teacher notification bell, session controls, profile, summary, and mobile header.
Adds a right-swipe gesture from the left edge to open the sidebar in the Android app.
Adds a left-swipe gesture to close an open app sidebar.
Removes repeated full Students collection reads and automatic roll rewrites during page load.
Shows the student roster first while attendance, fees, and reports finish loading in parallel.
Deduplicates realtime attendance and fee renders and batches rapid updates.
Caches attendance, fee, and report calculations for smooth filtering and pagination.
Disables expensive blur repaints and repeated row animations on the Students workspace.
Uses the full available width on the Students page, including wide desktop screens.
Restores a clean light-glass admin sidebar that matches the rest of the website.
Restores full text contrast in the Students Management hero section.
Uses a sharp 2px outer edge and compact 4px controls for the Students hero.
Removes the React compatibility shell, generated page chunks, Vite, and React runtime dependencies.
Opens the original Schoolix login and portals directly with no extra React loading layer.
Applies a consistent glassmorphism design across login, admin, staff, student, teacher, library, accounts, cards, tables, forms, and dialogs.
Keeps restrained ERP-style corner radii and limits card blur on mobile for smooth scrolling.
Adds a Daily Transactions section to Fees Report with an exact-date picker.
Automatically opens the most recent transaction day and provides quick Latest Day and Today actions.
Shows daily transaction count, amount received, time, student, payment mode, applied amount, extra amount, and transaction ID.
Reduces excessive rounding across cards, controls, icons, navigation, and dialogs.
Reveals pages immediately after the first render instead of waiting for images or idle time.
Removes the expensive full-page loader mutation scan and lowers the fallback wait to half a second.
Splits the React compatibility shell into 36 lazy page chunks, reducing its initial JavaScript from 3.18 MB to about 162 KB.
Reduces blur, hover movement, and heavy shadows for a sharper and faster ERP interface.
Introduces a cohesive enterprise design system across Schoolix portals.
Adds a professional light admin sidebar with clearer active navigation and hierarchy.
Refines KPI cards, quick actions, forms, tables, spacing, shadows, and status styling.
Improves responsive data views and touch controls on mobile screens.
Keeps student and teacher dark workspaces while improving their density and clarity.
Adds balanced rounded corners across cards, controls, menus, alerts, and dialogs.
Locks the page behind open modals so only modal content scrolls.
Uses the full viewport for reports, previews, documents, and other large modal content.
Bundles the latest full website and refreshed login screen.
Prevents repeated update prompts during downloads and repeated checks.
Shows download percentage and MB progress, and verifies APK version before installation.
Prevents student records from appearing before an academic session is verified.
Fixes student dashboard terms dropdown and subject marks fetching.
Synchronizes terms dynamically from terms collection, report cards, and saved marks.
Ensures results display reliably across all session structures and student ID formats.
Optimizes teacher dashboard load time with synchronous teacher identity and school branding cache.
Completely redesigns skeleton loaders across all panels with modern shimmer wave animations and collision prevention.
Fixes driver phones receiving app notifications when Send to everyone is used.
Adds driver notification registration and a drivers-only notification audience.
Shows active vehicles on the admin map faster after Start Tracking.
Uploads the driver's current GPS immediately when tracking starts.
Adds driver login support in the Android app.
Adds location permission handling for driver vehicle tracking.
Adds foreground GPS tracking when the school admin starts a vehicle trip.
Adds MapLibre live vehicle tracking in the admin and parent transport screens.
Adds an Open Link fallback on the update popup if the in-app downloader is blocked.
Fixes driver portal fallback when transport profile sync is pending.
Fixes student assigned vehicle live location lookup.
Adds clearer admin tracking setup diagnostics.
Fixes driver GPS upload fallback and 10-second live map refresh.
Adds moving live map pin with vehicle number and driver name.
Fixes driver assignment access so active-trip GPS uploads reach the admin map.
Keeps the driver's own exact You are here pin visible on the driver map.
Prevents duplicate GPS callbacks and repeated tracking-service starts.
Completely redesigns Vehicle Management as a modern fleet operations workspace.
Refines spacing, hierarchy, data density, and responsive fleet controls.
Aligns dynamic vehicle cards, route cards, action buttons, and mobile controls.
Restores the shared admin navigation shell and AI Assistant alignment.
Makes the Android APK use the same website login layout, colors, spacing, logo, and responsive form.
Hides Download Latest Android App inside the APK while keeping it visible on the website.
Adds pull-down-to-refresh on native app pages with a refresh indicator.
